title: Chapter 27 Witnessing The Destruction Of The Territory
content:
Chapter 27 Witnessing The Destruction Of The Territory

A puppy that had been running towards the northeast finally discovered something important.

A big battle was taking place in front of it.

Wu Qing entered the puppy's field of vision and dispatched all the nearby puppies in this direction.

Wu Qing saw that on the plain in front of him, there was a city that was many times larger than the city in Daxia Territory.

The tall city walls protected the safety of the city, and outside the city was an endless field.

This was the territory of a great lord!

However, now there were shouts of killing in the direction of the city, and tens of thousands of bear goblins and other strange races were attacking the city fiercely.

The city walls were full of soldiers of various races, mainly the Tengu clan, and both sides were engaged in a tragic city attack and defense battle.

The attackers threw stones of various sizes, and the defenders fired arrows and spears of various thicknesses, which shuttled back and forth over the battlefield like raindrops.

Under the city walls, there were fanatical soldiers climbing up the walls in various ways!

On the city walls, there was a bloody fight in close combat!

Some of the attacking soldiers have already climbed the city wall!

The entire battle line is very long, almost covering one side of the city wall.

In Wu Qing's opinion, the situation on the battlefield is very unfavorable to the defenders. The vanguard troops of the attacking side have already climbed the city wall, and the defenders can't even hold the city wall. Obviously, they are short of troops.

Judging from the state of the battlefield, this war should have been fought for more than one or two days, and the troops defending the city are exhausted after a long defense.

"This should be the largest native race territory nearby. With it in the front, the small territory behind can survive."

"Now this territory is about to fail, we have to do something?"

"With the current strength of the Zerg, participating in a war of this scale may not be very useful."

"The distance is too far and it is not suitable for a war of attrition. It takes a long journey to send dozens of puppies each time. In front of an enemy of this scale, rushing up is also a death sentence, which will not play a big role."

Although thinking so, Wu Qing still transferred most of the troops here.

Not fighting when there is a war is not in line with the character of the Zerg!

The important thing is to have resources!

However, before Wu Qing could continue to observe, there was a louder cheer from the battlefield ahead.

The city was broken!

Wu Qing was a little confused.

"What kind of luck do I have? I have only seen two local wars, and both times I was defeated in seconds?"

When he first arrived in this world, Wu Qing's camp was defeated in seconds in the first war.

He had to make a desperate escape.

Now he saw this larger-scale war, and he didn't hold on for a few more minutes. Now the city was broken, which can be regarded as a second defeat.

It takes time for the Zerg troops to rush over, and nothing can be done now.

The army of the bear goblin camp that broke through the city wall has launched a full-scale attack.

The other gates of the city that were not attacked were wide open, and countless people rushed out of the city and began to flee.

Now the enemy is still attacking the city with all their strength, and has no energy to pursue, so everyone still has a glimmer of hope to escape.

Once the strongest wall of the city was broken, the spirit that the defenders in the city had been holding on to was lost, and the attack of the bear goblin camp was unstoppable and soon broke into the city.

Wu Qing couldn't see the battle in the city, but from the number of soldiers from the bear goblin camp who kept rushing into the city, it can be inferred that the defenders were no match for the street fighting in the city.

A few more puppies ran over to the puppy that provided Wu Qing with vision. Wu Qing ordered them to approach the battlefield to obtain more detailed intelligence.

The puppy had the skill of drilling into the ground and quickly sneaked into the vicinity of the city. They mainly observed the fleeing crowd. As for the battle in the city, it was no longer worth paying attention to.

The ending was already doomed, and there was no way to change it unless a miracle happened.

More and more puppies who were exploring outside gave up their tasks, ran over, and joined the task of sneaking in and monitoring.

Wu Qing saw through the many monitoring puppies that all kinds of people escaped from the city, which showed that the city had long been unable to control the situation in the city and had no effective management and deterrence capabilities for ordinary residents.

There were already sporadic lizardman teams chasing and intercepting the fleeing native creatures.

Lizardmen, according to what Wu Qing learned, are one of the servant races of the bear goblins. They are relatively short in stature, like lizards that can walk upright.

They are ferocious and warlike, and are one of the main fighting races under the bear goblins.

Wu Qing saw a group of lizardmen intercepting a group of ordinary people from the Tengu tribe. A small number of young and strong people from the Tengu tribe rose up to resist, but they were still no match for the lizardmen soldiers and fell under the lizardmen's sticks.

The lizardmen did not slaughter the remaining Tengu tribe. The leading lizardman took out an object and held it high, shouting loudly: "God of the Spirit!"

"You pagans! Kneel down and pray! Ask for forgiveness from the spirit!"

"As long as the spirit forgives you! You will have a chance to live! Otherwise, you will all die!"

"Kneel down!"

Some people knelt down, and some people would rather die than surrender!

The lizardmen raised their butcher knives and killed all those who were unwilling to kneel down, regardless of gender, age or young!

Those who knelt down to pray were also picked out and killed by the lizardmen from time to time.

This scene was like a factory for forcing people to change their beliefs. Those who did not believe in my God had to die!

The Lizardmen were not in a hurry to chase others, as if what they were doing now was more important than chasing the enemy.

More and more lizardmen rushed over in groups to intercept the fleeing native creatures.

For those who were still in the city and had not escaped, the hope of escaping was getting slimmer and slimmer.

Wu Qing watched a few more forced conversions, and the Zerg army had arrived nearby.

2,000 puppies, 400 hydralisks, and 20 accompanying hosts.

"Spread out! Kill the lizardmen first!"

Wu Qing immediately issued an attack order.

The Zerg army was divided into small teams of different numbers, and killed the lizardmen who were chasing the fleeing native creatures.

"Everyone pay attention! These pagans have reinforcements!"

Soon, a lizardman noticed the puppies and hydralisks rushing over and issued a warning.

Based on the intelligence scouted in advance, the Zerg troops accurately killed the lizardmen. The size and combat power of these lizardmen were far inferior to those of the bugbears, and the puppies, who still had an advantage in number, could kill them all with a charge.

"Hurry up! Our reinforcements are coming!"

"Thank you, merciful Lord!"

Those who were intercepted by the lizards escaped death. No matter which lord's army the Zerg belonged to, they deserved to be thanked for coming to rescue them at this time.

After they were rescued, they immediately packed up and continued to escape.

Wu Qing saw the people who fled in all directions. He knew that most of them could not escape. They were either caught up by the pursuers behind them, or they could not reach other territories before dark and became a weird meal.

"These are all people. It's a pity to waste them!"

Wu Qing had some ideas about these people who fled.
